overview: The Marketing Support & Services for Handicrafts scheme aims to promote and market handicraft products through various initiatives such as participation in domestic and international exhibitions, organizing craft bazaars, and providing marketing assistance to artisans and handicraft exporters. It focuses on enhancing market access, brand building, and export promotion for the handicraft sector. The scheme supports individual artisans, self-help groups, NGOs, cooperatives, and private enterprises engaged in handicraft production.
objectives: Promote handicraft products in domestic and international markets
Enhance market access for artisans and handicraft producers
Support participation in national and international trade fairs and exhibitions
Organize craft bazaars and marketing events to showcase handicrafts
Provide financial assistance for marketing and publicity of handicrafts
Strengthen export promotion of handicrafts through market development assistance
Support branding and quality improvement initiatives for handicraft products
eligibility: Individual artisans, self-help groups, NGOs, cooperatives, and private enterprises engaged in the production of handicrafts are eligible to apply for benefits under the Marketing Support & Services for Handicrafts scheme. Applicants must be involved in handicraft activities and possess valid registration or recognition as handicraft producers where applicable.
benefits: Financial assistance for participation in domestic and international exhibitions, craft bazaars, and trade fairs; reimbursement of stall rent, travel expenses, and publicity costs; support for market development activities; assistance in branding and product promotion; facilitation of buyer-seller meets; and support for e-commerce initiatives and digital marketing of handicraft products.
financial_support: The scheme provides financial support in the form of subsidies for participation in exhibitions and fairs, including reimbursement of stall rent, travel expenses, and publicity costs up to certain limits. Assistance is also provided for organizing craft bazaars and marketing events, with funding shared between the implementing agency and the beneficiary. The exact quantum of support varies based on the nature of the event, location, and category of participant.
application_process: 1. Identify the relevant marketing event or exhibition under the scheme. 2. Contact the designated implementing agency or regional office for application details. 3. Submit the application form along with required documents. 4. Await scrutiny and approval from the sanctioning committee. 5. Upon approval, participate in the event and submit expenditure claims. 6. Receive reimbursement of eligible expenses as per scheme norms.
required_documents: Proof of identity and address of the applicant
Registration certificate (if applicable) as handicraft producer/artisan
Details of the handicraft products to be showcased
Quotation or invoice for stall rent and other expenses
Any other document as specified by the implementing agency
deadlines: Based on event-specific schedules; applications are typically invited well in advance of exhibitions, craft bazaars, and trade fairs.
implementing_agency: Office of the Development Commissioner (Handicrafts), Ministry of Textiles, Government of India
caveats: Financial assistance is subject to availability of funds under the scheme
Reimbursement is made only after submission of valid expenditure documents and participation proof
Benefits are limited to approved events and activities under the scheme
Artisans must ensure compliance with guidelines for product display and quality
